desc: ICEBERG LETTUCE stage0: match actual simple compact turquoise/cyan lettuce head wrapped in a few sharp-edged PALE MINT leaves. Prominent swept pointed top leaf and pointed side leaves, two big friendly black oval eyes, NO MOUTH. Thin attached white/iceblue frosted leaf base. Keep the recognizable actual lettuce shape with few clean leaf layers, not a full crystal crown or cabbage with extra arms.

FROST LETTUCE stage1: natural grown extension of actual Iceberg Lettuce. Slightly broader/fuller cyan lettuce face wrapped in more overlapping pale ice-blue and mint leaves. Jagged frosted LEAF EDGES and a small amount of angular ice at upper leaf tips; prominent swept top leaf. Friendly black oval eyes, NO MOUTH. More folded icy base leaves supporting continuous rosette, still a plant not a glass sculpture. No separate crown or jewelry.

GLACIER LETTUCE stage2: final natural evolved Iceberg Lettuce, broad full cyan/teal lettuce face wrapped in a layered rosette of pale icy mint leaves, large pointed upper leaves with attached CRYSTALLINE FROST TIP facets forming a natural lettuce-leaf crown silhouette. Distinct overlapping leaves remain visible; do not become a generic spiky ice monster or crystal orb. Friendly black oval eyes, NO MOUTH. Broad pale-blue folded base leaves with thin attached frost rim, no floating halo or detached shards. Biggest stage but keep compact lettuce proportions.
